notes.title: Queer and Chill - The Steam Awards 2022
notes.content:
If you liked Queer and Chill and was a inclusive game for you help us with visibility by nominating us for [b]"Labor of Love"[/b] in this year's Steam Awards edition!

Queer & Chill is a spicy and challenging puzzle full of pride flags, and lots of diversity. Improve your skills while discovering new and exciting ways to match people based on their sexuality.
Learn, evolve, and most of all, be curious.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: New people join the party! + Localization + Undo Mechanic
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are pleased to announce that this party is going bigger.
﻿
Localization:

﻿We added five new languages to the game interface and Steam store.

﻿- German
﻿- Portuguese-Brazil
- Italian
- Dutch
- French

Undo Mechanic:

﻿Now you can undo the last movment, try and retray until you get it!﻿

Thanks for playing and let's keep celebrating!

Queer and Chill Team.
